title: Privacy and preferences
deleteOrganizationDescription: The organization is suspended and its data is deleted. Subscription cancellation is confirmed with the provider; it may remain pending until the contracted period ends. Export the data you need first.
deleteAccountDescription: Before deleting your account, each organization where you are the sole owner must have a verified successor or complete deletion. Shared organizations and their subscriptions are preserved.
retentionNotice: Restricted security and financial records are retained. Backups expire under the storage policy; this status does not certify their erasure.
saveReceipt: Save this status link. It only allows viewing this request.
deletionConsent: I understand that confirmation revokes access and starts irreversible deletion.
accountIntro: Manage your data and choose how you hear from us.
organizationIntro: Export organization data and review the requirements for deletion.
personalExportDescription: Download a copy of your account data for your records.
organizationExportDescription: Create and download exports of the data you want to keep before deleting this organization.
analyticsDescription: Choose whether to share optional usage data to help improve the product. You can change this at any time.
analyticsNotConfigured: Analytics collection is currently disabled for this installation. Your preference will still be saved.
preferencesUnavailable: Your analytics preference could not be loaded. Try again to review it.
identityDescription: A recent identity confirmation is required to prepare and confirm deletion.
ownershipDescription: Make sure your organizations can continue without this account.
ownershipBlocked: Resolve the ownership requirements below before continuing.
ownershipReady: No ownership blockers. You can prepare a deletion request.
checkOwnershipFirst: Check ownership first to see whether your account is ready for deletion.
prepareHint: Preparing a request does not delete data. You will review and confirm it in the next step.
